advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test asserting review_and_vote does NOT call _emit_token_usage when the verdict carries no coverage.metrics (fail-closed path).
evidence: Diff comment: 'A fail-closed review carries no verdict/metrics → nothing recorded.'

test_review_and_vote_emits_token_usage_after_successful_vote only asserts `captured == [(...)]` on the metrics-present path (test file lines 204-233); no companion test asserts `_emit_token_usage` is NOT called when the verdict lacks coverage.metrics.
ABSENCE: no test in tests/unit exercises review_and_vote with a verdict whose coverage.metrics is absent/empty to confirm the guard skips emission.
advisory.finding: The `if _review_metrics:` guard in review_and_vote (voter.py:724) — which suppresses token emission for a fail-closed/no-metrics review — has no test for its negative branch. The integration test covers only the metrics-present path and monkeypatches `_emit_token_usage`, so removing the guard (calling `_emit_token_usage` with empty/absent metrics) would not fail any test.
scenarios: A fail-closed BLOCK decision (no verdict/coverage.metrics) reaches the successful-vote branch and the guard is later removed or inverted, causing `_emit_token_usage({})` to fire (or raise) with no regression signal.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a test mirroring test_review_and_vote_emits_token_usage_after_successful_vote but with a verdict lacking `coverage.metrics` (e.g. `{"verdict":"PASS","blocking":[],"advisory":[]}`), and assert `captured == []`.
